literal_meaning: এক মাত্র অদ্বিতীয় (one only, without a second)
figurative_meaning_en: The one and only unparalleled God/Allah/Ishwar
example_sentences_in_bangla: তিনি একমেব অদ্বিতীয়ম, কোনো দ্বিতীয় নেই।
আমরা বিশ্বাস করি যে ঈশ্বর একমেব অদ্বিতীয়ম।
example_sentences_in_english: He is one only, without a second.
We believe that God is one only, unparalleled.
history: Derived from the Chandogya Upanishad in ancient Hindu scriptures, where it describes the ultimate reality (Brahman) as singular and without parallel.
note: This is a Sanskrit phrase transliterated into Bengali, commonly used in religious and philosophical discussions in Bengali culture.
